{"attrs":{"schemaVersion":1},"content":[{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-91a85a403f60e1a4","level":1},"content":[{"text":"产品团队协作手册","type":"text"}],"type":"heading"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-39964bc3e84a41e7"},"content":[{"text":"本手册适用于我们这支十人小团队（1 名产品经理、1 名 UI/UX 设计师、1 名技术负责人、5 名研发、2 名测试），覆盖从需求提出到上线复盘的完整链路。手册只立三条硬约束：","type":"text"},{"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"评审不过不进开发、测试不过不进发布、排期不实不对外承诺","type":"text"},{"text":"。其余规则都围绕这三条展开。手册遵循"先共识、后执行"的修订原则——任何流程改动都要在团队会上过一遍，达成一致后才生效，不搞个人拍板。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-9b3660e35c269c47","level":2},"content":[{"text":"一、团队目标与原则","type":"text"}],"type":"heading"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-e302d54eb0299dfa"},"content":[{"text":"我们这一季只盯三个硬目标：","type":"text"},{"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"按时交付","type":"text"},{"text":"（承诺的迭代不跳票）、","type":"text"},{"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"质量不塌","type":"text"},{"text":"（上线后无 P0/P1 级事故）、","type":"text"},{"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"信息透明","type":"text"},{"text":"（进度、风险、变更随时可查，不靠私下打听）。三个目标互相牵制，任何一条被牺牲都要在周会上说清楚原因，而不是默默吞掉。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-b54da19b272f652f"},"content":[{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-b54da19b272f652f-p"},"content":[{"text":"需求要过评审，代码要过测试，承诺要过排期。评审不是走过场，是让每个人在动手前把话说清楚；测试不是找茬，是替用户把最后一道关；排期不是估算游戏，是给团队和外部一个敢信的数字。三关都过了，事情才真正开始。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"}],"type":"blockquote"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-9465e99daee61ec9","listStyle":"decimal","start":1},"content":[{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-9465e99daee61ec9-item-1"},"content":[{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-9465e99daee61ec9-item-1-p"},"content":[{"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"小步快跑","type":"text"},{"text":"：需求拆到两周内能交付的粒度，宁可多迭代几次，不憋大版本。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"}],"type":"listItem"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-9465e99daee61ec9-item-2"},"content":[{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-9465e99daee61ec9-item-2-p"},"content":[{"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"当面沟通、文档留痕","type":"text"},{"text":"：结论可以当面聊，但最终决定必须落到需求文档或评论里，事后可追溯。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"}],"type":"listItem"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-9465e99daee61ec9-item-3"},"content":[{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-9465e99daee61ec9-item-3-p"},"content":[{"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"结论当场明确","type":"text"},{"text":"：任何评审、站会、周会结束前，必须明确"谁、做什么、什么时候交"，不留"再想想"。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"}],"type":"listItem"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-9465e99daee61ec9-item-4"},"content":[{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-9465e99daee61ec9-item-4-p"},"content":[{"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"坏消息尽早说","type":"text"},{"text":"：发现延期、缺陷、需求变更，第一时间同步，不拖到最后一刻。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"}],"type":"listItem"}],"type":"orderedList"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-a9c839791c8069f5"},"content":[{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-a9c839791c8069f5-item-1"},"content":[{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-a9c839791c8069f5-item-1-p"},"content":[{"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"用户为先","type":"text"},{"text":"：一切需求与改动都以用户价值为最终标准。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-2886782d2b7e8d79","start":1},"content":[{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-2886782d2b7e8d79-item-1"},"content":[{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-2886782d2b7e8d79-item-1-p"},"content":[{"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"做法","type":"text"},{"text":"：需求进开发前先写清验收标准，由 PM 与 QA
